message-rules.putMessageRulesById.description: Saves an automatic message. Saving resumes a paused one.

message-rules.deleteMessageRulesById.description: Deletes an automatic message and cancels its runs that have not started.

message-rules.postMessageRulesByIdPause.description: Pauses an automatic message. Save it to resume.

message-rules.getMessageRulesByIdRuns.description: The messages an automatic message sent.

message-rules.postMessageRulesPreview.description: Counts the passes due each of the next 14 days.

message-rules.postMessageRulesByIdTest.description: Sends the text now to one pass.
